messages:
Jules Park: quick alert we had an onboarding pipeline error 02:102:23 UTC that blocked some CSV imports for trials (approx 10 tenants). IncidentBot: [INC-2024-721] created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2024-721 :rotating_light:
Omar Haddad: what was the root cause? any permanent data loss?
Selina Torres: root cause appears to be a tokenizer change that mishandled certain delimiter sequences in CSV fields. rolled back at 02:22 and new failures stopped. No deletions, but ~30 uploads returned 5xx and were dropped.
Jules Park: drafting customer note: short apology, confirmation of fix, steps we took, CTA to check Console > Onboarding > Import History, and offer 2-week credit + scheduled office hour for high-touch customers.
Priya Nair: please add renewal-risk flagging. I found 2 tenants on renewal watch (N-301, N-307)  prioritize AE outreach and manual retries.
Omar Haddad: ETA for retries? can engineering prioritize N-301/N-307 first?
Selina Torres: yes. priority retries started at 02:35 (job: retry-721-a). Expect confirmation within 45 mins. Bulk retries over next 3 hours. We'll post job IDs to INC-2024-721.
Jules Park: action list: 1) Priya/AE send personalized outreach to N-301/N-307 within 1 hour; 2) Eng run retries and link job IDs; 3) CS send broader outbound at 03:00 UTC. Approve?
Omar Haddad: Approved. I'll follow up with AEs.
Priya Nair: Sending AE notes now; will paste examples when sent.
IncidentBot: INC-2024-721 status updated: Investigating -> Mitigated at 02:25 UTC.
Jules Park: thanks team. I'll send the outbound at 03:00 and include the FAQ snippet and office hour link. React when tasks are done.
